units: Kel. XXII, 10 הנסרים … ששִׁיגְּמָן the boards in a bath which one planed; (Maim.: which one joined with bamboo, v. next w.).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26:6">Gen. R. s. 26</cite> (play on <he>בשגם</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 6:3">Gen. VI, 3</cite>) <he>הרי אני מְשַׁגְּמָן ביסורין</he> I will bend them through suffering; <he>הריני משגמן אלו באלו</he> (‘Rashi’ <he>מְשַׁגְּשָׁן</he>) I will bend them (break their power) one through the other; <cite ref="Genesis 6:3">ib.</cite> <he>ע״י שלא שִׁיגַּמְתִּי אותן וכ׳</he> because I had not bent them through suffering; Yalk. ib. 44.

senses.gloss: ) שֶׁגֶם m. (preced.) joint made of twisted reed (bamboo), hinge.—Pl. שְׁגָמִין or שִׁגְ׳, שׁוֹגְמִין.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26:6">Gen. R. s. 26</cite> (v. <cite ref="U00229">preced.</cite>) <he>הדלת הזה מי מעמידו שְׁגָמָיו</he> (or <he>שִׁגְמָיו</he>) what keeps the door in position? Its hinges.
Kel. X, 6 עשאן בסינין או בשוג׳ (Ar. a. Bart. בשג׳) if he joined the boards with tenons or with hinges (Maim.: with bamboo, v. סֵן).
